IMPORTANT QUALITY / ENGINE INTEGRATION

These are 1448×1086 RGBA AI-illustrated plates with uneven alpha and illustrative cell layouts. They LOOK substantially better than rejected blocky v1 and are good positive style/art sources. THEY ARE NOT verified 16×16 native tiles or normal 32×32 animation atlases. Many pixels are semi-transparent, so naive transparent import will yield fringes. Do not present as completed engine-usable tilesheets; clean crop/alpha, normalize native pixels/anchors, separate true frames, test tile adjacency and 320×180 iPhone game scale. Use them immediately as references, placeholders for iteration, or to re-author actual sprites. Existing importable P01 remains useful until better is validated:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sXUTCyW2FTt0xuBauWfgSrUpfVw3ET43
